extDescription.message: A Chrome extension that summarizes text on the current page using AI.

apiKeyLabel.description: Label for the API Key input.

apiKeyPlaceholder.message: Enter your Google Gemini API Key
apiKeyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the API Key input.

modelLabel.description: Label for the Gemini model selection.

modelHint.message: Only free-tier models are listed. Daily limits are per model, so you can switch models when one reaches its limit. The fastest, lowest-cost model is selected by default.
modelHint.description: Helper text under the model selector.

modelOptionLabel.description: Model option label with its free daily quota.

settingsSaved.description: Status message when settings are saved.

errorApiKeyNotFound.message: API Key not found. Please set it in the extension options.
errorApiKeyNotFound.description: Error message when API key is missing.

errorInvalidApiKey.message: Invalid API Key. Please check it in the options page.
errorInvalidApiKey.description: Error message for an invalid API key.

errorAuth.message: No access to the selected model, or the API key is invalid. Check your settings.
errorAuth.description: Error message for authentication or permission failures.

errorQuota.message: Free-tier limit reached. Wait a moment, or switch to another free model in Settings.

errorTimeout.message: The request took too long. Please try again.

errorNetwork.message: Network error. Check your internet connection and try again.

errorBlocked.message: This content could not be summarized for safety reasons.
errorBlocked.description: Error message when content is blocked by safety filters.

errorTruncated.message: The response was cut off. Please try again.
errorTruncated.description: Error message when the model stops early.

errorNoContent.message: There is not enough text on this page to summarize.
errorNoContent.description: Error message when the page has too little text.

errorModel.message: The selected model is unavailable. Choose another model in settings.
errorModel.description: Error message when the model ID is not available.

errorContextLost.message: The extension was updated or reloaded. Refresh the page and try again.
errorContextLost.description: Error message when the content script lost its extension context.

errorTitle.description: Title shown above an error message.

errorUnknown.message: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errorUnknown.description: Fallback error message for unexpected failures.

errorSaveSettings.description: Error shown when saving settings fails.

errorApiFailed.message: Failed to get a summary from AI. $details$

errorParse.message: Could not read the summary returned by the AI. Please try again.
errorParse.description: Error message when the response from the AI is unreadable.

loadingMessage.description: Message shown while the summary is being generated.

errorApiKeyMissing.description: Short error message for missing API key.

errorSetApiKey.description: Link text that opens the options page.

keyTermsTitle.description: Title of the optional key-terms section.

questionsTitle.description: Title of the optional open-questions section.

cachedLabel.description: Chip shown when a saved summary is reused.

languageWarning.description: Chip shown when the model did not use the selected summary language.

summaryByModel.description: Chip showing which model produced the summary.

retryButton.description: Retry button in the error view.

closeLabel.description: Accessible label for the close button.

refreshLabel.description: Accessible label for the refresh button.
